capabilities: Define button properties with labels and Templater file paths globally
Render clickable buttons inside Bases table cells
Run Templater templates against the note in the clicked Base row
Suggest matching template file paths while typing in settings
Confirm button runs on mobile before executing
extras: Not yet in the community directory, so it must be installed manually from GitHub releases; the README warns that DOM manipulation of Bases views may break with future Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: render as clickable buttons in core Bases tables
problem: Obsidian Bases tables have no built-in way to trigger an action or run a template from a table cell.

relations.evidence: Each button runs a configured Templater template against the note represented by the property
This plugin is based on the original Custom Selectors plugin by hodie.

summary: Adds configurable button properties to Obsidian Bases tables that run Templater templates against the note in the clicked row.
